thread:
sara: Quick flag 5: onboarded Asteria-v2 q4 on staging and ran the locale smoke. Seeing strange reflows: ruby annotations (furigana) get separated by spaces and paired punctuation around RTL spans gets mirrored.

rui: can you paste a tiny example? sounds like detok or bidi handling

sara: yes. baseline (fp32):
> E8AAA4E381EFBC88E381E3A383E381EFBC89E381AB
> (shows furigana as attached)

q4 output:
> E8 AA A4 E3 81 1A EF BC 88 E3 81 1A E3 A3 83 E3 81 1A EF BC 89 E3 81 AB

sophia: those \u00E sequences make it hard to read here but i get the idea: inserted spaces between codepoints

kenji: Did tokenizer or detok versions change in the quant build? that spacing usually indicates a tokenizer vocabulary remap or whitespace-inserting pass

sara: Tokenizer pinned to v2.2 in the recipe. However the q4 runtime applies a lightweight post-merge pass to try to avoid over-merged tokens in long japanese runs. We thought that would only combine, not split.

rui: Hmm. Could be that the post-merge uses byte-level ops that don't preserve grapheme clusters. Also reported mirrored parentheses for Arabic inside Japanese lines? That suggests bidi reordering firing on tokens that include punctuation as separate tokens.

sophia: Do we have per-token ids for the failing examples? a token-level diff between fp32 and q4 would be useful

sara: Attached diffs are in CI artifact /ci/artifacts/2834567890/token_diff.txt. Quick summary: many kana tokens are split into single-codepoint tokens in q4. Also parentheses surrounding Arabic spans are tokenized as separate punctuation tokens and then detok runs bidi heuristics that mirror them because the surrounding token order changed.

eval-bot: quick eval summary: ja-zh BLEU fp32=25.8, q8=25.1, q4=22.0. Grapheme continuity metric dropped from 0.97 to 0.88 on the sample set.

kenji: given q8 is close to fp32, it's likely specific q4 kernel rounding or the post-merge transformation. Can you triage whether the post-merge pass is enabled only for q4 binaries?

sara: yes it's enabled via runtime flag --enable-postmerge-heuristic (was turned on for quant builds to reduce merges). I reran q4 with flag disabled and q4 BLEU improved to 24.6 and continuity to 0.96.

sophia: OK that pins it to the heuristic. Next: bisect the heuristic change set and check whether it's using codepoint iteration vs grapheme cluster iteration. If it's the latter, we might need to switch to ICU-aware ops.

rui: I'll start a bisect across the heuristic commits. sara can you make a minimal repro of three failing lines and a tiny script that runs fp32 vs q4 with/without the flag and emits token ids?

sara: on it. repro script will be at /ci/repro/2834567890/repro.sh. For mitigation, I'm reverting the heuristic in staging and pinning q4 recipes to --enable-postmerge-heuristic=off.

kenji: good. Also add a targeted test into the multimodal smoke suite that contains mixed ja/zh/ar parentheses + ruby annotations so we catch regressions in future.

sophia: I'll add that test (200 synthetic examples) and include the grapheme continuity check in the CI gate.

eval-bot: nightly run scheduled with heuristic disabled for q4 at 02:30 UTC. Artifacts will land at /ci/artifacts/2834567890/

sara: thanks all. I'll post the bisect status when rui narrows suspects. tagging @kenji @sophia for visibility and follow-up.
